INSERT INTO flow_index (type, content_module, content_id, times, user_id, create_time) VALUES
(#{flowIndex.type},#{flowIndex.contentModule},#{flowIndex.contentId},#{flowIndex.times},#{flowIndex.userId},#{flowIndex.createTime})
mapper.select: SELECT user_id AS userId, content_id AS contentId, LEAST(5, ( -- 基础互动评分（浏览、点赞、收藏） (total_views * 0.25 + total_upvotes * 0.35 + total_collects * 0.4) * 0.7 + -- 时长奖励分 CASE WHEN total_duration < 6000 THEN 0 WHEN total_duration < 20000 THEN 0.5 WHEN total_duration < 60000 THEN 1.2 ELSE 1.8 END ) * -- 活跃度调节因子 (1 + LOG(1 + (total_views + total_upvotes + total_collects) / 10)) ) AS score FROM (SELECT user_id, content_id, content_module, SUM(CASE WHEN type = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS total_views, SUM(CASE WHEN type = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS total_upvotes, SUM(CASE WHEN type = 4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS total_collects, SUM(CASE WHEN type = 5 THEN times ELSE 0 END) AS total_duration FROM flow_index WHERE type IN (2, 3, 4, 5) -- 浏览(2)、点赞(3)、收藏(4)、停留(5) AND content_module = #{contentModule} GROUP BY user_id, content_id, content_module HAVING total_views > 0 OR total_upvotes > 0 OR total_collects > 0) AS aggregated_data ORDER BY score DESC
